title: transit: ingestion queue capacity hardcoded at 1024
description: Why: ingestion_queue(1024) in main.rs:264 is hardcoded. Under high ingest load operators may need to tune this; it should be a config field so the queue depth can be raised without recompiling.\n\nWhat: Add ingestion_queue_capacity field to transit config (e.g. under [peering] or [ingestion]), default 1024, wire into the ingestion_queue() call in main.rs.
